name: Amaranth Powdery Mildew
description: A fungal disease affecting amaranth leaves with white powdery growth, primarily on older leaves. It reduces leaf quality and market value, especially in dense plantings during humid conditions.
symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on upper leaf surfaces
Yellowing and browning of affected leaf tissue
treatments: Apply sulfur-based fungicides at first signs
Spray neem oil solution (5ml/L water) weekly
Use potassium bicarbonate (1 tbsp/L water) as organic treatment
Remove and destroy severely infected older leaves
prevention: Space plants adequately for air circulation
Remove lower leaves to improve air flow
